To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

different competitive structures can have different effects on self-efficacy, learning outcomes, and engagement in technology mediated training programs, and the choice of the competitive structure depends on the priority given to learning or engagement outcomes.
different competitive structures have differential effects on learning and engagement outcomes.
the effects of different types of competition in a gamified training program are not the same and depend on whether learning outcomes or engagement is the priority.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the gamification of technology-mediated training, and the effects of different types of competitions on trainee learning outcomes and engagement.
the design and evaluation of gamification in technology-mediated learning.
the effects of different game design elements, specifically competitive structures, on technology-mediated training.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
gamification of technology-mediated training is not all the same, and the choice of game design elements depends on the training context and the training objectives.
gamification is a powerful tool for improving training outcomes, but the choice of gamification elements and the design of gamified training depends on the training context and the desired outcomes.
the effect of gamified competitions on learning and engagement depends on the type of competitive structure.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the effects of gamification are not universal.
the choice of competitive structures should be based on the desired learning and engagement outcomes in training.
competition in technology mediated training can be effective for learning outcomes, but not for learner engagement.
The main takeaway from our work is that
game designers should consider both the learning outcomes and the engagement outcomes when choosing the competitive structure in gamified training designs.
the choice of competitive structure in gamified learning designs should be informed by the learning and engagement outcomes targeted.
the design of competitive elements in gamification is a complex process and requires careful consideration of multiple factors.
